post.description: Creates a refund receipt in Loyverse.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

receiptNumber.description: The sales receipt number for a refund

receiptDate.description: By default, it matches the created_at value (time when receipt was created on the Loyverse server). You can set receipt_date to the value that is equal to the date and time in the past when the refund was created in another system.

source.description: The name of the the source this receipt comes from. By default it is the name of the application that created the receipt.

employeeId.description: The employee id associated with the receipt

storeId.description: The store id associated with the refund receipt. By default, it matches the store id of the sales receipt.

lineItems[].description: The line items included in the refund

cancelledAt.description: The time when this receipt was cancelled

createdAt.description: The autogenerated date and time when the receipt was created in Loyverse.

customerId.description: The customer id associated with the receipt

diningOption.description: The dining option selected for the receipt

employeeId.description: The employee id associated with the receipt

cost.description: The cost of the single item at the moment of transaction

costTotal.description: The total cost for this line item at the moment of transaction

grossTotalMoney.description: The total money amount for this line item including modifiers. It doesn't include discounts and taxes which type is ADDED.

id.description: The unique id that identifies this line item in the receipt

itemId.description: The item id for this line item

id.description: The discount id

moneyAmount.description: The money amount of this discount for the line item. The value is always positive.

percentage.description: The percentage of the discount. For example value 10.55 corresponds to a percentage of 10.55%. The value is not set for amount based discounts.

lineDiscounts.description: The list of discounts applied to the line item

id.description: The modifier id

modifierOptionId.description: The modifier option id applied to the line item

moneyAmount.description: The total money amount of the modifier applied to the line item. It is equal to the price of the modifier option multiplied by the line item's quantity

option.description: The name of the modifier option applied to the line item

price.description: The base price of a single modifier option

lineModifiers.description: The list of modifiers applied to the line item

id.description: The tax id

moneyAmount.description: The money amount of this tax for the line item

rate.description: The rate of the tax. For example, a value of "5.255" corresponds to a percentage of 5.255%

lineTaxes.description: The list of taxes applied to the line item

price.description: The price of the one item. It includes taxes which type is INCLUDED. It doesn't include modifiers, discounts and taxes which type is ADDED.

quantity.description: The number of items that were purchased (or refunded in case of refund)

totalDiscount.description: The total discount amount applied to the line item. The value is always positive.

totalMoney.description: The total money amount for this line item after applying discounts and all taxes for this line item

variantId.description: The variant id for this line item

variantName.description: The variant name (for example XL / Red)

lineItems.description: The line items included in the receipt

order.description: The order name or number associated with this receipt

moneyAmount.description: The total money amount of this payment (including tips and surcharge)

name.description: The name of the payment type

paidAt.description: The time when this payment was created

paymentDetails.description: The payment details for integrated payment types

authorizationCode.description: The authorization code associated with the transaction

entryMethod.description: The entry method of the credit card on the terminal (if available)

referenceId.description: An id attached to the transaction by the gateway

pointsBalance.description: The customer's points balance after transaction

pointsDeducted.description: The total amount of points deducted from customer's points balance (in case of refund). The value is always positive.

pointsEarned.description: The total amount of points added to customer's points balance

posDeviceId.description: The POS id where the receipt was paid

receiptDate.description: By default, it matches the created_at value. You can set receipt_date to the value that is equal to the date and time in the past when the receipt was created in another system.

receiptNumber.description: The internal identifier for the receipt. It is unique.

refundFor.description: The number of a different sales receipt that is associated with this refund. (Only for refund receipts)

source.description: The name of the the source this receipt comes from. By default it is the name of the application that created the receipt. For receipts created from Loyverse mobile point of sale application the value is "point of sale".

storeId.description: The store id where the receipt was paid

surcharge.description: The total surcharge money amount for the receipt

tip.description: The total tip money amount for the receipt

totalDiscount.description: The total amount of all discounts applied in the receipt (including discount by points). The value is always positive.

id.description: The discount id

moneyAmount.description: The total money amount of this discount for the receipt. The value is always positive.

percentage.description: The percentage of the discount. For example value 10.55 corresponds to a percentage of 10.55%. The value is not set for amount based discounts.

type.description: The type of the applied discount

totalDiscounts.description: The list of discounts and it's amounts applied to the receipt.

totalMoney.description: The total money amount paid by customer (or returned to customer in case of refund). The value includes discounts, taxes, surcharges and tips. The money amount format depends on country of account registration  (for example for Japan there is no decimals in money amounts)

totalTax.description: The total amount of all taxes (VAT and sales tax) applied in the receipt

id.description: The tax id

moneyAmount.description: The total tax amount applied for the receipt

rate.description: The tax rate. For example, a value of 5.255 corresponds to a percentage of 5.255%

totalTaxes.description: An array of tax line objects

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the receipt was updated.
